description:
Department of Veterans Affairs Network 21 Contracting Office will be issuing a Request for Proposal (RFP) for the requirement titled Modernize Outlying CBOC Building Automated Systems (Guam/Samoa), VA Pacific Islands, Honolulu, Hawaii.   
This procurement is a Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business Set Aside.  The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code is 236220, with a size standard of $45M. 

Solicitation Info:  Solicitation is being conducted under FAR Part 15. All responsible sources may submit a proposal which shall be considered. The anticipated posting of this solicitation is May 21, 2026, and closes June 22, 2026, at 10:00 AM Pacific Time. In accordance with FAR 5.102(d), availability of this solicitation will be limited to the electronic medium. 

Site Visit: 
A site visit may be scheduled, and the date will be posted with the request for proposal. 
Inquiries:
All contractual and technical questions must be submitted in writing by email to charee.harris@va.gov and christopher.aguon@va.gov.  No telephone questions will be accepted. 

Notifications: 
Notification of any postponements and any amendments to this solicitation will be posted on this website. It is the sole responsibility of the offeror to continually view this website for any amendments made to this solicitation.
